meta.name: SpectraStrobe A/B colour calibration (ratio + transition shape + L/R)
meta.description: Controlled A/B diagnostic for issue #31: the colour-calibration WAV shows visible states but the crossfades appear to fade to black on the Kasina, although offline verification finds no encoded black gap. This A/B varies the colour level (ratio to the reference) and the transition shape, and includes a matched L/R alternation, so ratio, transition shaping and stereo behaviour can be separated observationally.
meta.diagnostic_ladder_note: The colour levels are a controlled diagnostic ladder, NOT artistic settings and NOT a recommendation.

three_levels: digital ratio: the encoded amplitudes in the WAV (measurable offline)
hardware output: decoder thresholds, LED transfer and diffuser behaviour (not measured here)
perception: what the observer sees (not measured here)

peak_policy.note: Every variant must stay at or below -6 dBFS sample peak and -6 dBTP; the renderer hard-fails otherwise and applies no normalisation.

hardware_exposure_policy.ceiling_note: The 25% ceiling is the former conservative research convention: 25% of the -36 dBFS reference peak per active colour carrier, i.e. colour at -48.04 dBFS. It is not a proven physical safety threshold and not a decoder specification.
hardware_exposure_policy.gated_note: Gated variants are offline-verified but are not for hardware playback without a separate explicit decision.
hardware_exposure_policy.mindplace_scale_note: The MindPlace -24 dBFS full-brightness scale is a different scale from the -36 dBFS reference and the 25% ceiling; percentages must not be conflated across scales.

correction.summary: Correction — owner decision 5 Nov 2026. The former 25% conservative ceiling is 25% of the -36 dBFS reference peak per active colour carrier, i.e. colour at -48.04 dBFS. Only direct-m54p1 (12.45% of ref) and the new -48.1 boundary variants (24.83%) are under the ceiling. direct-m42p0 (50.12%), direct-m36p0 (100%), direct-m30p0 (199.53%) and direct-m24p0/overlap-24/lr-24 (398.11%) are ABOVE the ceiling and gated.
correction.previous_error: The earlier protocol/report text labelled only m30/m24/overlap/LR as above the ceiling; m42p0 (50.1% of ref) and m36p0 (100% of ref) were also above and are now gated.
correction.ceiling_status: conservative research convention; not a proven physical safety threshold and not a decoder specification
